verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own automations (Release Pipelines, scheduled flags) and a four-eyes Change Request review workflow, which pipelines can generate automatically when promoting to production. Audit logs let you retrace past flag, identity and segment values, a history-style partial stand-in for versioning. There is no documented rollback or revert of automations or pipeline definitions. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of release pipelines/scheduled automations, a documented rollback/revert capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production
Feature Change Requests help creating a four-eyes workflow (create, approve, publish) to updating feature flags, similarly to Pull Requests in GitHub.
This allows you to easily retrace the events and values that flags, identities and segments have taken over time.
Define stages that your flags progress through automatically, with triggers and actions that control rollouts to selected environments and audiences.
